narrative:
Crawford County has 27,287 registered voters, with 16.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 47.6%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 16.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.1% of registrants.
